alarm: causal, at the K-th consecutive step with p <= alpha_eff
calibration: out-of-fold scores, 5 contiguous blocks, 30-window purge on each side; test scores from the full-training fit (cross-conformal approximation, Vovk 2015); chronos2 is zero-shot, so its training-series scores are used directly (split conformal)
near_zero_spread: sd of the out-of-fold calibration scores < 1e-06 (ar_ridge: constant training target; pca, knn: constant training series)
saturation: alarm on more than 0.9 of the test steps (label-free)

subsets.attainable: channels where alpha_eff == alpha for every detector
subsets.nondegenerate: unsaturated channels where no detector has near-zero spread
subsets.note: channel sets common to every detector (per_channel.csv flags; summary suffixes)

event_fp: maximal alarm segments outside every labelled sequence
esa_ew_precision: TP / (TP + alarm runs touching no sequence) * (1 - nominal_alarm_fraction)
reference: always_on: in alarm on every test step
surrogates: 200 label-free alarms per channel and detector built from its alarms; shift: circularly shifted by a uniform offset; block: one block of its alarm time at a uniform start (both position-uniform); swap: the alarms reassigned among the channels of the spacecraft by a uniform random permutation, each stretched to its new channel's length by relative position (keeps the alarm positions; the null for channel-specific detection); late: one block of its alarm time at the end of the series (one draw, a reference; no p-value); *_<kind>: mean pooled metric; *_<kind>_p: (1 + #{surrogate >= detector}) / (draws + 1)
pointwise_steps: test steps where telemanom has scores (250 .. n_test - 10), for every detector
pointwise_auc_pr: mean over channels of the per-channel AUC-PR
pointwise_auc_pr_pooled: pooled steps; each channel's scores mapped to conformal p-values against its out-of-fold training scores; steps above every calibration score tie at 1 / (n_cal + 1), so saturated or near-zero-spread channels fill the top of the ranking (ordered by n_cal); not for telemanom
pointwise_auc_pr_pooled_raw: telemanom only (no training scores): pooled raw errors, the published convention
point_adjusted_f1: on the pointwise steps; for contrast only
note: thresholds fixed a priori; no test labels used for any choice
